#         # dep-graph-tri-tokio-hyper-tonic-001

        **Suite:** dependency_management | **Type:** dependency_graph | **Difficulty:** expert
        **Repos:** tokio + hyper + tonic

        ## Context

        The Rust gRPC stack uses tonic (gRPC) → hyper (HTTP/2) → tokio (async
runtime). A tokio version bump can cascade through hyper into tonic.

Your task:
1. Map the full dependency chain: tonic → hyper → tokio with exact
   version constraints from each Cargo.toml
2. Identify which tokio APIs hyper uses that tonic depends on transitively
3. Find any version pinning conflicts across the three repos
4. Document the upgrade coordination strategy

Write your analysis to /workspace/analysis/IMPACT_REPORT.md

        ## Expected Output

        Write your analysis to `/workspace/analysis/IMPACT_REPORT.md`.

        Your report should include:
        - File paths from each repository that are relevant
        - Specific code symbols, functions, or types involved
        - The nature of each change (removal, rename, signature change, behavioral)
        - Migration recommendations

        ## Hints

        - All repos are cloned under `/workspace/`
        - Focus on import/dependency declarations first, then trace into implementation
        - Check version constraints in dependency manifests (Cargo.toml, go.mod, pom.xml, requirements.txt)


Search only these repositories: github.com/sg-evals/tokio--tokio-1.0.0, github.com/sg-evals/hyper--v0.14.0, github.com/sg-evals/tonic--v0.6.0

The report is written. Here is a summary of the findings:

---

## Analysis Summary

### Dependency Chain (exact constraints)

```
tonic v0.6.0
  ├── hyper     = "0.14.4"   (transport feature)   ← tonic/Cargo.toml:74
  ├── tokio     = "1.0.1"    (transport feature)   ← tonic/Cargo.toml:76
  ├── tokio-util = "0.6"     (always)              ← tonic/Cargo.toml:61
  └── tokio-stream = "0.1"   (always)              ← tonic/Cargo.toml:77

hyper v0.14.0
  └── tokio = "1"  features = ["sync"]             ← hyper/Cargo.toml:36
      + tokio/net, tokio/rt, tokio/time            (via runtime/tcp features)

tokio v1.0.0
  ├── tokio-util   = 0.6.0  (path dep)
  └── tokio-stream = 0.1.0  (path dep)
```

### Two Blocking Conflicts Found

| # | Constraint | Repo ships | Status |
|---|-----------|-----------|--------|
| 1 | tonic requires `tokio >= 1.0.1` ([tonic/Cargo.toml:76](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/tonic--v0.6.0/-/blob/tonic/Cargo.toml?L76)) | tokio ships `1.0.0` ([tokio/Cargo.toml:11](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/tokio--tokio-1.0.0/-/blob/tokio/Cargo.toml?L11)) | **BLOCKED** |
| 2 | tonic requires `hyper >= 0.14.4` ([tonic/Cargo.toml:74](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/tonic--v0.6.0/-/blob/tonic/Cargo.toml?L74)) | hyper ships `0.14.0` ([Cargo.toml:3](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/hyper--v0.14.0/-/blob/Cargo.toml?L3)) | **BLOCKED** |

### tokio APIs hyper uses (transitively required by tonic)

- **`tokio::io`** — `AsyncRead`, `AsyncWrite`, `ReadBuf`: used across server, client, H1/H2 protocol layers, and HTTP upgrade machinery ([src/upgrade.rs](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/hyper--v0.14.0/-/blob/src/upgrade.rs?L15), [src/server/tcp.rs](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/hyper--v0.14.0/-/blob/src/server/tcp.rs?L226))
- **`tokio::net`** — `TcpListener`, `TcpStream`: power `AddrIncoming`/`AddrStream` which tonic imports directly ([src/server/tcp.rs:6](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/hyper--v0.14.0/-/blob/src/server/tcp.rs?L6), tonic [incoming.rs:7](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/tonic--v0.6.0/-/blob/tonic/src/transport/server/incoming.rs?L7))
- **`tokio::time`** — `Sleep`, `Instant`, `Interval`: accept error back-off, H2 keep-alive, connection pool idle eviction ([src/proto/h2/ping.rs:63](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/hyper--v0.14.0/-/blob/src/proto/h2/ping.rs?L63))
- **`tokio::sync`** — `oneshot` (HTTP upgrades), `watch` (graceful drain) ([src/upgrade.rs:16](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/hyper--v0.14.0/-/blob/src/upgrade.rs?L16), [src/common/drain.rs:4](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/hyper--v0.14.0/-/blob/src/common/drain.rs?L4))
- **`tokio::task::spawn`** — default H2 stream executor ([src/common/exec.rs:48](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/hyper--v0.14.0/-/blob/src/common/exec.rs?L48))

### Upgrade Coordination (required order)

1. **Bump tokio `1.0.0` → `1.0.1`** (patch, no API changes expected)
2. **Bump hyper `0.14.0` → `0.14.4`** (patch; verify `AddrIncoming`, `hyper::Server::builder`, `hyper::client::connect::Connection` remain stable)
3. tonic v0.6.0 requires no changes once both above constraints are met

The full report with all file references, risk matrix, and migration steps is in [IMPACT_REPORT.json](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/.api/agent-files/v1/deep-search/f872f3bf-57ef-4eeb-9cb0-334392834213/files/IMPACT_REPORT.json).
